description: This file contains the implementation of the 'git diff' builtin command for Git, including functions for various diff operations such as diff between blobs, index, trees, and handling command-line arguments and options.

methods.name: const char * blob_path(struct object_array_entry * entry)
methods.description: Returns the path or name of an object array entry, providing a flexible way to get the reference string for a file or object.

methods.name: void stuff_change(struct diff_options * opt,unsigned old_mode,unsigned new_mode,const struct object_id * old_oid,const struct object_id * new_oid,int old_oid_valid,int new_oid_valid,const char * old_path,const char * new_path)
methods.description: Prepares and queues a diff change between two file states, handling various options like path prefix and diff reversal.

methods.name: void builtin_diff_b_f(struct rev_info * revs,int argc,const char ** argv UNUSED,struct object_array_entry ** blob)
methods.description: Handles diffing a blob versus a file in the working directory, setting up the necessary diff structures.

methods.name: void builtin_diff_blobs(struct rev_info * revs,int argc,const char ** argv UNUSED,struct object_array_entry ** blob)
methods.description: Handles diffing between two blob objects, setting up and invoking the diffing process.

methods.name: void builtin_diff_index(struct rev_info * revs,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Processes diff operations involving the index/staging area, supporting options like --cached and --merge-base.

methods.name: void builtin_diff_tree(struct rev_info * revs,int argc,const char ** argv,struct object_array_entry * ent0,struct object_array_entry * ent1)
methods.description: Computes the diff between two trees or a merge base and a tree.

methods.name: void builtin_diff_combined(struct rev_info * revs,int argc,const char ** argv UNUSED,struct object_array_entry * ent,int ents,int first_non_parent)
methods.description: Handles combined diff of multiple parent commits or merge bases.

methods.name: void refresh_index_quietly(void)
methods.description: Quietly updates the index, discarding current index state and reloading it.

methods.name: void builtin_diff_files(struct rev_info * revs,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Diffs files in the working directory against the index or working directory against each other, supporting various options.

methods.name: void symdiff_prepare(struct rev_info * rev,struct symdiff * sym)
methods.description: Prepares data structures for symmetric diff operations, validating command-line revision arguments.

methods.name: void symdiff_release(struct symdiff * sdiff)
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for the symmetric diff structure.

methods.name: int cmd_diff(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main function executing the 'git diff' command, handling command-line parsing, setting up revisions, and calling appropriate diff functions based on arguments.
